scope: READONLY grade-envelope feasibility assessment, not a geometry/vehicle/obstacle approval. Uses the exact explicitly bound source-corrected ordinary core heights and optional pending node targets, with detailed source-corrected graph lengths. Rerun against final solved core before producing any changed tile overlay. No road/profile/activation changed.

method.softPreference: Retain source node profile within feasible envelopes; no forced zero at a short edge far endpoint.
method.qualification: Graph feasibility is a necessary endpoint-grade test. C1/true triangle grade, all source access/widths, protected bridge/rail, historical headroom, owner/context copies and complete vehicle/obstacle checks remain mandatory.
